evidence.observation: At 2026-03-22T14:05:12Z auth-gateway deployed change AUTH-2026-0318, setting jwks_namespace=partner-v2 and issuer=partner-v2.

At 2026-03-22T14:08:34Z auth-gateway logged validation failed reason=issuer_not_allowed with token_issuer=partner-v2 while allowed_issuers remained partner-v1, which shows a bad issuer configuration after the change.
payment-api rejected checkout request req-8812 because auth-gateway returned issuer_not_allowed / invalid_issuer before any order-db work.
checkout-web failed submit_order with status=401 from payment-api and logged auth_failed invalid issuer, matching the downstream auth break.
At 14:10Z, auth-gateway 401 rate rose to 28.4, payment-api 401 rate rose to 21.2, and checkout-web 401 rate rose to 18.7, showing the failure propagated along the checkout dependency chain.
Topology shows checkout-web depends on payment-api, which depends on auth-gateway; AUTH-2026-0318 is the only recent auth-gateway change listed.

excluded_red_herrings.why_not_primary: orders-db metrics show p95 query latency normal and errors=0, payment-api states order-db was not used before the auth gate on failing requests, and orders-db logged that failed checkout request req-8812 never reached it.
cdn-edge errors were isolated to static images, checkout-web logged static assets served normally after retry, and user checkout remained blocked by payment auth failures rather than asset delivery.

recommended_next_steps: Mitigate now by restoring allowed_issuers to include partner-v2 or by rolling back AUTH-2026-0318 on auth-gateway.
Flush or rebuild the JWKS cache namespace so partner-v2 tokens resolve without fallback to partner-v1 settings.
Verify after mitigation that auth-gateway no longer logs issuer_not_allowed for partner-v2 tokens and that payment-api invalid_issuer errors stop.
Confirm checkout-web submit_order requests return to normal success/latency and 401 rates drop across auth-gateway, payment-api, and checkout-web.
Add a config validation or canary check to catch issuer/JWKS namespace mismatches before deploy.
